personal.name: Priyank Agrawal
personal.title: PhD Candidate
personal.tagline: RL theory · LLM post-training · Agentic AI

paragraphs: Hi! Welcome to my website. I am a final-year PhD candidate at Columbia University, where I work with the fabulous Shipra Agrawal (graduating September 2026). I love discovering connections between reinforcement learning and modern AI systems, and thinking about how to improve decision-making in the wild.

Most recently, I was a student researcher at Meta (Nov 2025 – Apr 2026), designing RLVR post-training algorithms for reasoning LLMs — including Off-Context GRPO, which leverages privileged information to learn on hard problems. On the theory side, I prove guarantees for RL algorithms — planning and exploration, regret and sample-complexity analysis for Q-learning with posterior sampling and optimism, and actor-critic convergence. To me these are one agenda: exploration, credit assignment, and decision-making under uncertainty are exactly the algorithm-design questions that agentic AI systems run on. My current interests span LLM post-training (RLVR, RLHF, reward modeling), agent harness design, and inference-time optimization.

My research is supported in part by a Tang Family Fellowship and a Cheung-Kong Innovation Doctoral Fellowship. Before Columbia, I earned a Master's in Computer Science from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign in Nan Jiang's RL theory group, and in the past I was a strategist at Goldman Sachs.
Reach out if you find all of the above interesting too!
